title: Quantum contextuality with mixed states of 1D symmetry-protected topological order
summary: Bell theorems of many-body nonlocality and contextuality serve as a benchmark for proving quantum advantage in that a quantum computer outperforms a classical computer for a certain problem. In practice, however, near-term quantum devices do not prepare perfectly pure states but rather mixed states produced from noisy channels. We investigate noisy quantum advantage by considering thermal mixed states of one-dimensional many-body systems with a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) order.
